stem.text: The diagrams show the structure of four amino acids in aqueous solution.

stem.label: glycine
stem.alt: Displayed structural formula of glycine, with the carboxylate group COO-, the ammonium group N+H3 and a hydrogen atom on the central carbon, labelled glycine.

stem.label: lysine
stem.alt: Displayed structural formula of lysine, with an H3N+ group, a chain of four CH2 groups, and a central carbon bearing a hydrogen atom, a COO- group and an N+H3 group, labelled lysine.

stem.label: alanine
stem.alt: Displayed structural formula of alanine, with a CH3 group, a central carbon bearing a hydrogen atom, a COO- group and an N+H3 group, labelled alanine.

stem.label: aspartate
stem.alt: Displayed structural formula of aspartate, with a carboxylate group O- and C=O on one end, a CH2 group, a central carbon bearing a hydrogen atom, a COO- group and an N+H3 group, labelled aspartate.
